population.definition: Census count (RGPH-3, 2018, final figures) for the district Antananarivo Renivohitra, which comprises Antananarivo city; listed as 'Urban'. Males 615,659; females 658,566. The page does not define 'urban commune' further.

source.title: Antananarivo Renivohitra (District, Madagascar) - Population Statistics, Charts, Map and Location
source.publisher: citypopulation.de (citing Institut National de la Statistique Madagascar)
source.quote: The 2018 figures are final.

facts.claim: Andrianjaka became king of Merina in 1610 and ruled until 1630; he made Antananarivo the new capital.

source.title: Merina Kingdom (EBSCOhost Research Starter)
source.author: Alice Myers
source.quote: In 1610, Andrianjaka ("the prince who rules") became the king of Merina and ruled until 1630.

facts.claim: Andrianjaka renamed the settlement Antananarivo to reflect the one thousand warriors stationed there.

source.title: Merina Kingdom (EBSCOhost Research Starter)
source.author: Alice Myers
source.quote: to reflect the one thousand warriors stationed there

facts.claim: The city was the capital established and named by Andrianjaka and became the capital of the Merina kingdom; it remains Madagascar's capital.

source.title: Merina Kingdom (EBSCOhost Research Starter)
source.author: Alice Myers
source.quote: the capital city established and named by Andrianjaka in the seventeenth century

places.name: Rova of Antananarivo
places.what: The Rova is the royal compound on the city's highest hill, where Andrianjaka built a wooden royal palace. Several of its buildings were destroyed by fire in 1995, and restoration is ongoing.

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: Andrianjaka built the wooden rova on the hill's highest ground.

source.title: Merina Kingdom (EBSCOhost Research Starter)
source.author: Alice Myers
source.quote: wooden rova, or royal palace

facts.label: Founding layout
facts.value: Andrianjaka had the plateau cleared and fenced with stakes.

source.title: Le Rova de Madagascar dans les années 1950
source.author: Pela Ravalitera
source.quote: Aussitôt, il fait déboiser et dénuder le plateau et l'entoure de pieux.

facts.label: Reburial 1897
facts.value: On Gallieni's orders the sovereigns' remains were placed at the Rova on 15 March 1897.

source.title: Le Rova de Madagascar dans les années 1950
source.author: Pela Ravalitera
source.quote: Les restes de ces souverains furent déposés, le 15 mars 1897, sur les ordres du général Gallieni

facts.label: Not just one palace
facts.value: The Rova is a set of buildings, not only Manjakamiadana palace.

source.title: PATRIMOINE - Trente et un ans après, le Rova ravive la mémoire nationale
source.author: Cassie Ramiandrasoa
source.quote: Le Rova d'Antananarivo ne se résume pas au palais de Manjakamiadana.

places.name: Analakely market and the Zoma
places.what: Analakely is a central district whose market took over from the Zoma, a large open-air weekly market in the heart of the city. The Zoma was removed at the end of the 1990s and has returned in event form.

facts.label: Origin of the Zoma
facts.value: Created by a powerful king at the end of the 18th century.

source.title: La suppression du marché du Zoma à Tananarive
source.author: C. Fournet-Guerin
source.quote: It was created by a powerful king at the end of the eighteenth century

facts.label: Setting
facts.value: A big open-air market at the heart of the city.

source.title: La suppression du marché du Zoma à Tananarive
source.author: C. Fournet-Guerin
source.quote: Zoma was a big open-air market located at the heart of Antananarivo

facts.label: Removal
facts.value: The city authorities removed it at the end of the 1990s with no protest.

source.title: La suppression du marché du Zoma à Tananarive
source.author: C. Fournet-Guerin
source.quote: there were no protest when the city authorities decided to remove it at the end of the 1990s

facts.label: Return
facts.value: The Zoma, once weekly, now returns as daily or seasonal events at Analakely.

source.title: MARCHÉ - Le Zoma revient à Analakely
source.author: Mialisoa Ida
source.quote: Le marché du Zoma, autrefois hebdomadaire, revient désormais avec l'organisation d'événements journaliers ou saisonniers.

places.name: Tsimbazaza Botanical and Zoological Park
places.what: A park in the city that began as a botanical garden and also keeps animals, notably ring-tailed lemurs. It holds a herbarium and a library bequeathed by the Grandidiers.

facts.label: Creation
facts.value: Created 29 August 1925 by Governor General Marcel Olivier; 12 hectares at first.

source.title: PBZT: le juridique et le politique
source.author: VANF
source.quote: à sa création le 29 août 1925 par le Gouverneur Général Marcel Olivier

facts.label: Area
facts.value: 16 hectares in 1932; 27 hectares after a 1934 annexation.

source.title: PBZT: le juridique et le politique
source.author: VANF
source.quote: la surface du Parc atteindra 27 hectares

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: It started as a botanical garden.

source.title: PBZT: le juridique et le politique
source.author: VANF
source.quote: Il fut d'abord un jardin botanique

facts.label: Lemurs
facts.value: The ring-tailed lemur is described as emblematic.

source.title: PBZT: le juridique et le politique
source.author: VANF
source.quote: emblématique «Lemur catta» (maki) à la queue annelée

places.name: Andafiavaratra Palace (Prime Minister's palace museum)
places.what: A stone palace built for Prime Minister Rainilaiarivony, now partly a museum. Its main exhibits are objects rescued from the 1995 Rova fire.

source.title: The Palace of the Prime Minister
source.author: Masika sipa
source.quote: for the then Prime Minister Rainilaiarivony

facts.label: Stone building
facts.value: Replaced a wooden first palace in 1872; supervised by British architect William Pool.

source.title: The Palace of the Prime Minister
source.author: Masika sipa
source.quote: replaced by the present stone building in 1872

facts.label: Museum
facts.value: Ground-floor rooms house the Andafiavaratra Museum.

source.title: The Palace of the Prime Minister
source.author: Masika sipa
source.quote: the palace houses the Andafiavaratra Museum in some rooms on the ground floor

facts.label: Collection
facts.value: Main exhibits are objects rescued from the 1995 Rova fire.

source.title: The Palace of the Prime Minister
source.author: Masika sipa
source.quote: The main exhibits are the objects rescued from the Rova fire in 1995.
